changes.before: A customer asks for a quote through your website, calls to clarify the scope, then emails a change. One team member has the form, another remembers the call, and the latest quote is somewhere in an inbox. The customer is waiting, but nobody is certain who should act next.
changes.after:
Say you run a landscaping business in Perth. A customer asks for a quote through your website, calls to clarify the scope, then emails a change. You have the form, a colleague remembers the call, and the latest quote is somewhere in an inbox. The customer is waiting. Who should act next?

That is the fictional situation we will use throughout this guide.
